requirements.requirement: Identify and characterize one or more useful Earth analogues for Moon or Mars. Explain supported characteristics, breakdown and exploration use. A single site or process and a method-led tool are allowed. Less-studied analogues are encouraged; all dimensions need not match.

requirements.requirement: Click Submit for Judging by 2026-11-15 23:59 in the team Local Event time zone. Submission opens 2026-11-14 09:00. Universal Event uses the Team Owner residence time zone. Local judging may differ.

requirements.requirement: A demo is required: up to seven slides including title and intro, OR a video of 30 seconds or less. Exceeding the limit prevents Global Judging eligibility.
requirements.section: Project Page Form Field Instructions/Link to Project Demo;Tips for Creating a Project Demo/Limitations

requirements.requirement: Use English in the project form and linked materials. Slide decks must be English. A non-English spoken video must include English subtitles.
requirements.section: Tips for Creating a Project Demo/Language Requirements;Submitting Your Project

requirements.requirement: Demo and final-project links must work without password, permission or registration. Host documents/videos externally. The form accepts JPG, PNG or GIF images up to 10 MB.
requirements.section: Sharing Files to Your Project Submission Page;Link to Project Demo;Link to Final Project

requirements.requirement: Use at least one NASA datum or resource for Global Award eligibility and explain its contribution.
requirements.section: Project Page Form Field Instructions/NASA Data

requirements.requirement: Cite all used data, resources, tools, code, text and images, including open/free sources. Identify third-party licences and verify rights and public availability.

Original content must be freely available without restriction or OSI licensed. Terms state NASA uses Apache 2.0 if no specific OSI licence is specified. Team approval was previously pending; the official fallback is not team approval.

The guide calls AI tools SI. Describe where and how they were used. Acknowledge code/data assistance in descriptive text and metadata. SI-generated images/videos need a visible watermark; generated audio needs descriptive-text/metadata acknowledgement. Generated content must not use, contain or modify NASA branding or design elements.

requirements.requirement: All members must be confirmed at the same Local Event. Maximum six members. Local Event minimum one; Universal Event minimum two.
